basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 48, pp. 63-65）

Shin, Junhyoung Michael. “The Face-to-Face Advent of the Amitābha Triad: A Fifteenth-Century Welcoming Descent.” Cleveland Studies in the History of Art, vol. 6, 2001, pp. 28–47.（Reproduced: fig. 8, p. 40）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
南無阿彌陀佛

馆方英译：Namo amituofo or "Homage to the Buddha Amitābha"

沙門善導

馆方英译：Inscription and seal purportedly of Shandao (613–681), Tang dynasty patriarch of the Pure Land school, on the lower left side of the painting.

觀世音菩薩

馆方英译：Bodhisattva Guanyin (Avalokiteśvara)

大勢至菩薩

馆方英译：Dashizhi Bodhisattva (Mahāsthāmaprāpta)

永隆元年十月十五日

馆方英译：Inscription on the lower right side of the painting: the fifteenth day of the first month of the first year of the Tang Emperor Taizong's Yonglong reign period [680/681].
